title: stabilization round two audit fixes

commit.merge_subject: merge: stabilization round two audit fixes

description:
Fix 5 of the stabilization round-2 audit (2026-11-12): the
zoom-limit slider showed a ceiling the user set, but nothing showed
the crop the clip ACTUALLY pays or when that limit was cutting the
warp's reach. The stabilization group now renders an honest zoom
readout beside the sync status line.

The probe chain (all new plumbing, zero core change):
- jni_bridge.cpp nativeStabZoomProbe: evaluates the full stab plan
  for frame 0 at the clip's recorded CFA dims through the existing
  stabilizationFrameFor (with a StabMeasure), returning
  [requiredZoom, appliedZoom, statusInt] or null. The zooms are
  uniform-scale invariant (focalLengthPxFromEquivalent and
  staticCropZoom are both linear in buffer dims), so one probe per
  grade change covers every preview tier and the export. Null on a
  dead handle / no log / parse failure - never a fabricated zoom.
- NativeSource: private external dec
changed: fix: stabilization warp at every preview tier
fix: strength tau map spans useful range
docs: sync status says approximate not precise
feat: zoom-limit honesty readout in stab group
